title.narrative: PROPCOM Promoting Pro-Poor Opportunities Service Markets (PROPCOM) -Procurement of Services

description.narrative: This activity PROPCOM Promoting Pro-Poor Opportunities Service Markets (PROPCOM) -Procurement of Services is a component of Promoting Pro-poor Opportunities in service and Commodity Markets (PrOpCom) reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £17,059,065. It works in the following sector(s): Small and medium-sized enterprises (SME) development, Rural development, Trade policy and administrative management, Agricultural policy and administrative management, Livestock.
